lead: A refusal over a derived fact fires on declarations already refused for something else, and the existing `--EXPECTF-ERROR--` case is what catches it.
body: Refusing a `#[Json\Derive]` class whose field list came out empty also hit `reject/a-json-derive-refuses-a-secret-or-lateinit-field.nvst`, whose properties are both refused. Before adding a diagnostic whose condition is the absence of a result, grep the reject tree for a case that already makes that result absent, and model the outcome per item (kept / skipped / refused) rather than as an `Option`.
